'''Greeley''' was the [[Director/Legends|Director]] of [[Cartography and Surveying]], [[Halthor sector/Legends|Sector O-1]], in the employ of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Greeley was the recipient of a Survey Team Report - STR 2434, completed by Commander [[Trask (commander)|Trask]], recommending that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]] was unsuitable for Republic colonization.
